scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Cone shaped red Santa hat is too ordinary.
It's old fashioned.
Maybe in 1980's?!
Haha~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
尖尖的红色圣诞帽太普通了，早就过时啦。
难道还活在1980年代吗？！
哈哈~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
If you leave it on me,
I'll change it to lastest model.
You know what I mean~!
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
交给我，我就能把它改成最新款。
你懂的~！

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
You know Antonio's hat,right?
Guess who made it?
As you know, Antonio is hard to catch,
that's because I blowed some power in the hat.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
你知道安东尼奥的帽子吧？
猜猜是谁做的？
安东尼奥那么难抓，就是因为我给那顶帽子注入了魔力。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
If you don't like your hat,
bring it to me.
I'll change it to brand new one.
Stylish Louise's hat.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
不喜欢现在的帽子，就拿来给我吧。
我给你换一顶全新的时尚路易丝款帽子。

scripts.text: Here.
scripts.translation: 给你

scripts.text: It's ok.
scripts.translation: 不用了

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Nice choice!!
If I do it like this ...
and this and...
finally it'll turn into fantastic hat.
But before that,I need some materials to make with.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
好选择！！
如果我这样做...
再这样，还有...
最后它会变成一顶绝妙的帽子。
不过在那之前，我需要一些材料。

scripts.text: What are the materials?
scripts.translation: 需要什么材料？

scripts.text: So what? I don't want to know.
scripts.translation: 算了，我不想听

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Well, nothing special.
Basically, you need Santa's hat of course.
and with a touch of my magical fingers,
it'll just turn into very special thing.
Well,just little bit prettier and
little bit more practical. Haha...
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
没什么特别的，首先当然得有一顶圣诞帽。
再经我这双魔法巧手一改，它就会变得与众不同。
嗯，就是更漂亮一点，也更实用一点，哈哈...

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Anyway,to sum up,required materials are....
Basically ^0000FFSanta's Hat^000000 and
 ^0000FF 1 Cactus Needle ^000000 for sewing, 
^0000FF 10 Holy Water ^000000 for blessing, 
^0000FF 1 Rosary ^000000 for luckiness.
It's pretty enough to make Louise Hat.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
总之，需要的材料是...
^0000FF圣诞帽^000000
^0000FF1个仙人掌刺^000000，用来缝帽子。
^0000FF10个圣水^000000，用来施加祝福。
^0000FF1个念珠^000000，用来带来好运。
这些就够做一顶路易丝帽了。

scripts.text: Here you are.....
scripts.translation: 给你...

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Wow~~!! So fast!!
I like your style~.
Ok!! If everything is ready, no need to hesitate.
I'll show you what Designer Louise Kim's power is.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
哇~~！！这么快！！
我就喜欢你这么爽快的人~！
材料齐了就别犹豫，让你见识一下设计师路易丝·金的实力！

scripts.text:
-She puts the hat in a bucket -
-filled with Holy Water.-
-She rapidly takes it out and starts mending the hat-
-humming a tune.-
scripts.translation:
-她把帽子浸入装满圣水的桶中。-
-接着迅速取出，一边哼歌，一边开始修补帽子。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~With the number one designer, Louise Kim,~
~you are the most blessed soul.~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
~有首席设计师路易丝·金相伴，~
~你就是最受祝福的人。~

scripts.text:
-Immediately, she puts Rosary in an-
-unknown liquid and dissolves it.-
-And with a brush,-
-neatly coats the liquid on -
-a thread of the hat.-
scripts.translation:
-她立刻把念珠放进一种不明液体中溶解。-
-随后用刷子把液体均匀地涂在帽子的线上。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~With the number one designer, Louise Kim,~
~you are the luckiest soul.~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
~在首席设计师路易丝·金面前，~
~你是最幸运的灵魂。~

scripts.text:
-She starts sewing the hat with -
-a Cactus Needle and a thread.-
scripts.translation: -她开始用仙人掌刺和线缝制帽子。-

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
~This is called the Louise's miracle.~
~The most talented disigner,~
~L_O_U_I_S_E K_I_M~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
~这就是路易丝的奇迹。~
~最有才华的设计师，~
~L_O_U_I_S_E K_I_M~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Here!! All done~~
How do you like it?
Isn't it so wonderful?
Take it!! It's a gift.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
来！！大功告成~~
怎么样，是不是很棒？
拿着吧！！送给你。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
I should have called high price for it
but as you know it's Christmas!
It's a gift for you!
I won't charge anything.
Just tell many people how good it is.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
本来应该收你一大笔钱，不过现在可是圣诞节！
就当礼物送给你，不收费。
帮我多宣传宣传它有多好就行。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Wherever you go,
whatever you do,
never take off the hat.
You won't have a chance to buy it
no matter how much you pay.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
不管去哪里、做什么，都别摘下这顶帽子。
这可是花多少钱都买不到的。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Alright~Go ahead~
Go brag yourself!
~Who would be happier than~
~being with Louise.~
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
好了~去吧~去炫耀一下！
~有路易丝相伴，~
~谁能比你更幸福？~

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Come on~If you just get me the materials,
I won't charge anything,
Call me if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
来嘛~只要带齐材料，我就不收费。
改变主意了就来找我。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
You'll regret!
Think again!
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
你会后悔的！
再想想吧！

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Ok~ whatever~
It's not me,
who's going to lose whose own luck.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]
好吧~随便你~
反正错过好运的人又不是我。

scripts.text:
[Designer Louise Kim]
Perhaps you get the chance to acheive Santa's Hat later some time,
think about it carefully.
You can get the better designed hat,
and I can show off my talent.
scripts.translation:
[设计师 路易丝·金]

你能得到更漂亮的帽子，我也能展示自己的才华。

拐杖糖！
这是修女长做的，又甜又好吃。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Piece Of Cake!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very soft and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
小蛋糕！
这是服事长烤的，松软又好吃。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Cookies!
These were baked by
Chief Acolyte.
Very crispy and delicious.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
饼干！
这是服事长烤的，香脆又好吃。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Spore Doll!
It's made elaborately by
Bishop, Tomas.
Very cute.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
魔菇娃娃！
这是托马主教精心制作的。
非常可爱。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Baphomet Doll!
..........?!..........
How did it get in here..?!
Oops, oh well.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
巴风特娃娃！
...？！...
怎么会混进来...？！
啊，算了。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Osiris Doll!
..........?!..........
How did it get in here..?!
Oops, oh well.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
俄塞里斯娃娃！
...？！...
怎么会混进来...？！
啊，算了。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Rocker Doll!
This was donated by
a knight, Lighten.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
摇滚蝗虫娃娃！
这是骑士莱顿捐赠的，他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Yoyo Doll!
This was donated by
an assassin, Marzia.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
溜溜猴娃娃！
这是刺客马尔齐亚捐赠的，他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Racoon Doll!
This was donated by
a hunter, Raiden Kurs.
Very kind of him.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
浣熊娃娃！
这是猎人雷登·库尔斯捐赠的，他真好心。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Black Cat Doll!
Sister Magareta found the item
from the monster, Loli Ruri.
Very kind of her.
Hope she is doing okay.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
黑猫娃娃！
玛格丽特修女从萝莉·露莉身上
捡到了这个物品。
她真好心。
希望她一切都好。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Hung Doll!
I made this doll.
Isn't it adorable?!
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
吊颈娃娃！
这是我做的娃娃。
是不是很可爱？！
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Munak Doll!
That is from some country
across the ocean.
An artisan made this doll
with his passion.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
僵尸娃娃！
这是从大洋彼岸的某个国家带来的，一位工匠倾注心血制作了它。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
A Santa Hat!
This is only produced
during Christmas season.
It is not a common hat.
Merry Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
圣诞帽！
只有圣诞节期间才会制作，可不是普通的帽子。
圣诞快乐！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Welcome back!! You look good.
2 arms and 2 legs, you look great.
But, where is my music book?!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
欢迎回来！！看起来还不错嘛。
两只胳膊两条腿，都好好的。
可我的乐谱呢？！

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Thank you very much.
People and even Devils are
all excited on Christmas day,
so nobody knows what would
happen. Will you help me
then, won't you? Please~
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
非常感谢。
圣诞节连恶魔都会和人们一样兴奋，谁也不知道会出什么事。
要是有事，你还会帮我吧？拜托啦~

scripts.text:
[Oholy]
Let's think about the neighbors
and do a good deed during Christmas!
scripts.translation:
[奥霍利]
让我们为邻居着想，在圣诞节行善吧！

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
Heyhey, human!!
Don't ya wanna sell your
soul and be bound in a beneficial contract with me?
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
嘿嘿，人类！！
要不要出卖灵魂，跟我签个划算的契约？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey, you! Deviruchi!!!
What a brat!!! Gotcha!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嘿，你！小恶魔！！！
真是个坏蛋！！！抓住了！

scripts.text:
-You quickly snatched-
-the nape of Deviruchi's neck-
scripts.translation: -你一把抓住小恶魔的后颈。-

scripts.text:
[Deviruchi]
What are you doing!?
Human?
Let go of me...right now!
scripts.translation:
[小恶魔]
人类，你干什么！？
放开我...马上！

scripts.text:
-Deviruchi quickly ran away-
-^4d4dffWhere Deviruchi is gone,-
-there is a worn out paper.^000000-
-Let's read the paper.-
scripts.translation:
-小恶魔飞快地逃走了。-
-^4d4dff它离开的地方，留着一张破旧的纸。^000000-

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Rudolph... If... Foggy...
Sledge... Reindeer...
Hmm, I think I got what I need.
Let's go back to Ms.Oholy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鲁道夫...如果...雾...
雪橇...驯鹿...
嗯，这应该就是我要找的东西。
回去找奥霍利女士吧。
